text: In March 2025, the UAE's Federal Supreme Court rejected the appeals of 53 people convicted in a 2024 mass trial, upholding convictions that Human Rights Watch called unfair.

source.name: Human Rights Watch: UAE: Unfair Mass Trial Convictions Upheld
source.quote: An Emirati court on March 4, 2025, rejected all appeals by people convicted in the United Arab Emirates’ second-largest unfair mass trial

additionalSources.name: AFP (via Macau Business): UAE rejects appeals of 53 sentenced in mass trial
additionalSources.quote: The United Arab Emirates has rejected the appeals of 53 people convicted earlier in a mass trial, most of whom had been sentenced to life
